label: Bible Study
prompt: A soft answer turneth away _____: but grievous words stir up anger.
verse: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
note: Soft answers cost nothing and defuse everything — grievous words do the opposite.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee _____.
verse: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
note: The benediction lands on 'peace' — shalom, wholeness — the last word before the amen.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my _____, we will serve the LORD.
verse: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
note: The plaque verse: Joshua speaks for his whole house, and countless hallway walls ever since.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So teach us to _____ our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verse: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
note: Moses' math lesson: count your days honestly and wisdom starts adding up.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may _____ you as wheat:
verse: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
note: Satan asked to run Peter through the sieve. Jesus' answer, next verse: 'I have prayed for thee.'
